hero.title: Re-architect the physics of AI
hero.subtitle: Don't iterate on legacy silicon. Build the fundamental compute substrate for the next generation of intelligence.

best_work.heading: Do the best work of your life

cards.title: Unprecedented Impact
cards.description: Ship silicon that rewrites the power-performance frontier. Your work enables AI capabilities that were physically impossible yesterday.

cards.title: Pure Technology Depth
cards.description: Operate at the intersection of analog circuit design, machine learning architectures, and condensed matter physics. No abstraction layers.

cards.title: Unconstrained Co-Creation
cards.description: Build alongside the researchers who invented AIMC. Direct access to founders, zero bureaucracy, full technical autonomy.

dna.heading: Driven by physics. Defined by our DNA.
dna.subtitle: This is how we work, build, and solve at Ambient.

panels.title: Grounded in Science
panels.description: You work from first principles. Every decision you make is expected to be backed by data, validation, and a clear understanding of the underlying system.

panels.title: Stay Curious. Stay Skeptical.
panels.description: You are encouraged to question, challenge, and refine. Strong thinking, clear reasoning, and continuous learning are expected at every stage of the work.

panels.title: Chase the Impossible
panels.description: You take on problems that don't have predefined solutions. The expectation is not iteration, but pushing beyond accepted limits and building what doesn't yet exist.

panels.title: Build for Everyone
panels.description: Your work is not isolated. You build systems that must scale across real-world environments, constraints, and users, making advanced technology practical and usable.

panels.title: Protect What Powers Us
panels.description: You design with power as a constraint from day one. Efficiency is not an afterthought, it is a core part of how you think, build, and optimize systems.

open_roles.heading: Open Roles
open_roles.general_app_subtitle: Submit a general application and we'll reach out when a matching position opens.

cards.title: Comprehensive Health Coverage
cards.description: Medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your family. Mental health support included.

cards.title: Competitive Compensation
cards.description: Top-of-market salary and significant equity grants. Annual performance reviews with real upside.

cards.title: Equipment And Tools
cards.description: Latest MacBook Pro, external displays, and any specialized hardware or software you need.

cards.title: Office Perks
cards.description: Daily catered lunch, premium coffee setup, and fully stocked kitchen. Relocation assistance available.

cards.title: Learning Budget
cards.description: $5,000 annual budget for conferences, courses, books, and professional development.

cards.title: Unlimited PTO
cards.description: Take the time you need. We trust you to manage your work and recharge when necessary.

bottom_cta.heading: Ready to build the future of compute?
